name: Squire Maltrake
summary: After The Torch of Retribution, Kalaran Windblade sends you on to Squire Maltrake, an envoy of theirs. Maltrake will tell you how the torch is to be used.

sections.title: A Word with the Envoy
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade points you toward Squire Maltrake, an envoy. Maltrake is the one who will explain how the Torch of Retribution is to be used.

faq.q: Who sends you to Squire Maltrake?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade, who calls Maltrake an envoy and tells you to go and hear their instructions.
Maltrake is the envoy Kalaran Windblade names, and will instruct you on how the Torch of Retribution is to be used.

faq.q: What comes before speaking to Squire Maltrake?
aliases: what quest comes before squire maltrake
faq.answer: The Torch of Retribution, the step before it in the same chain.
